description: llmdoc lifecycle hooks run through the plugin-side hooks/llmdoc-hook-launcher.mjs wrapper (located via the plugin root, not the consumer cwd). The wrapper delegates to the scoped llmdoc CLI through an npm alias that cannot be shadowed by a same-name local dependency, and stays fail-open even if that launch cannot install/resolve/start or times out: SessionStart emits a plain diagnostic, Stop and PreCompact emit {continue:true,systemMessage} JSON, and all three exit 0. Hooks are read-only and fail-open: they report the bound knowledge protocol's review obligations and source blockers, never write the source or knowledge repository, and never initialize a binding.
